correctness.rationale: The exact return map is \(\widehat g=\widetilde g\lVert g\rVert_2/(\lVert\widetilde g\rVert_2+\varepsilon)\). Its norm is bounded by \(\lVert g\rVert_2\), and exact cancellation forces zero. The scalar pair \(a,-a\) has pure-mask output \(\pm a\) but rescaled output \(0\).
